notes.title: Q/A
notes.notes: As a college student who's recently moved to Europe, it can be hard to find time to fix Darkstorm. With that said, the amount of hours I've poured into the project shouldn't be unaccounted. As such, I've read some amazing, (and also not so amazing), feedback on the game. I want to hear from you, what you'd like to see and such. Alongside that, I have considered making the game open source, meaning that YOU have the power to add and modify it as you see fit. Let me know what you think.

notes.title: DARKSTORM UPDATE!
notes.notes: Included lots of bug fixes to the game, three levels and a tutorial, and the option to choose STORY or ENDLESS WAVE. I also included a terminal area where you can purchase or upgrade your weapons!
